# About this dictionary

Every column of the Kriminalita SQLite database is described here as a *data element*
(ISO/IEC 11179): an **object class** (the ontology class the table realises), a
**property** (the ontology property the column realises) and a **value domain**
(type, range, allowed codes). The dictionary is generated from the ontology
(`ontology/kriminalita.ttl`, `ontology/reference/`) and the SHACL shapes
(`ontology/shapes.ttl`); it is never edited by hand. The same content is in the
database table `meta_column`, in `db/data-dictionary.csv`, and, for review with a
*Comments* column, in `db/data-dictionary.xlsx`.

Where a column realises a generic reused property (e.g. `dcterms:identifier`), its
definition is a local data-element definition stated on the shape, so that every
column has a domain-specific meaning.

| Field | Generated from |
|---|---|
| Table | kdb:table |
| Column | kdb:column |
| Data element (en) | sh:name@en |
| Data element (cs) | sh:name@cs |
| Definition | skos:definition of the ontology term, or of the shape for reused properties |
| Scope note | skos:scopeNote of the ontology term |
| Object class IRI | sh:targetClass |
| Object class | rdfs:label of the target class |
| Property IRI | sh:path |
| Property | rdfs:label of the property |
| Value domain | sh:datatype, sh:class, ranges, pattern, languages |
| SQL type | generated from sh:datatype / referenced key |
| Cardinality | sh:minCount, sh:maxCount |
| Nullable | sh:minCount |
| Key | kdb:primaryKey, sh:class |
| Business rule | sh:description |
| Source field (CSV) | kdb:sourceField |
| Status | vs:term\_status |
| Ontology release | owl:versionInfo |

: Dictionary fields and their sources {tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

# Table `kraj`

**Realises:** kraj (`krim:Kraj`)

A kraj is a self-governing territorial unit of the Czech Republic, the highest level below the state, listed in the Czech Statistical Office's codelist 100, identified by its four-digit code and corresponding to one EU NUTS 3 region.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not one of the eight kraje of 1960, which RÚIAN still keeps, and not a NUTS 2 cohesion region (not modelled). Includes Prague (3018), which is governed by its own act (131/2000), not by the Act on kraje (129/2000). The Czech term is kept in English: "region" is ambiguous.

| Column | Data element | SQL type | Null | Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iri` | kraj IRI | TEXT | no | UNIQUE |
| `code` | kraj code | INTEGER | no | PK |
| `name_cs` | kraj name (Czech) | TEXT | no |  |
| `nuts_iri` | NUTS 3 region | TEXT | no |  |

: Columns of kraj {tbl-colwidths="[28,32,12,8,20]"}

# Table `orp_area`

**Realises:** ORP area (`krim:OrpArea`)

An ORP area is a territorial unit of the Czech Republic that is the administrative district of a municipality with extended powers, listed in the Czech Statistical Office's codelist 65 and identified by its four-digit code.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not the municipality with extended powers itself (the town of Opava is a municipality; the ORP area is the district its office serves), and not the smaller POU district, which is not modelled. Includes Prague (code 1000), which ČSÚ and RÚIAN list as an ORP area although Prague is not one in law. An ORP area normally lies within one okres; Turnov (5109) spans three.

| Column | Data element | SQL type | Null | Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iri` | ORP area IRI | TEXT | no | UNIQUE |
| `code` | ORP area code | INTEGER | no | PK |
| `name_cs` | ORP area name (Czech) | TEXT | no |  |
| `kraj_code` | kraj | INTEGER | no | FK -> kraj(code) |

# Table `okres`

**Realises:** okres (`krim:Okres`)

An okres is a territorial unit of the Czech Republic between the municipality and the kraj, defined by Act 51/2020, listed in the Czech Statistical Office's codelist 101 and identified by its five-digit code.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not a self-governing unit, and no longer an EU statistical unit (LAU 1 was dropped in 2017; ČSÚ keeps the codes). Not the okres of the repealed Act 36/1960, although most boundaries carried over. The Czech term is kept in English: "district" is ambiguous.

# Table `municipality`

**Realises:** municipality (`krim:Municipality`)

A municipality is a territorial unit of the Czech Republic listed in the Czech Statistical Office's codelist of municipalities and military training areas (ČSÚ codelist 43) and identified by its six-digit code.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not a city district or a part of a municipality. Includes the four military training areas (Boletice, Březina, Hradiště, Libavá): they are not municipalities in law (Act 128/2000) and hold no elections, but they are treated as municipalities here. RÚIAN uses the same codes.

# Table `anonymisation_area`

**Realises:** anonymisation area (`krim:AnonymisationArea`)

An anonymisation area is a geographic feature, one of a fixed set of polygons defined by the publisher, to whose centre the location of every offence record falling inside it is moved before publication.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not an administrative unit, and not the true place of an act. The publisher computed the areas once: municipalities were split into Voronoi polygons around K-means cluster centres of the 2018 data, and municipalities with fewer than 25 offences in 2018 were left whole. The list is published as a fixed file (2022). An area exists whether or not any record falls in it.

| Column | Data element | SQL type | Null | Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iri` | anonymisation area IRI | TEXT | no | UNIQUE |
| `id` | area id | INTEGER | no | PK |
| `centre_latitude` | centre latitude | REAL | no |  |
| `centre_longitude` | centre longitude | REAL | no |  |
| `municipality_code` | municipality | INTEGER | no | FK -> municipality(code) |

: Columns of anonymisation_area {tbl-colwidths="[28,32,12,8,20]"}

# Table `clearance_state`

**Realises:** clearance state (`krim:ClearanceState`)

# Table `location_relevance`

**Realises:** location relevance (`krim:LocationRelevance`)

A location relevance is a concept that classifies the recorded location of an offence record by what that location stands for in relation to the act.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Says what the place means, not how precise it is; all published locations are anonymised.

| Column | Data element | SQL type | Null | Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iri` | location relevance IRI | TEXT | no | UNIQUE |
| `code` | code | INTEGER | no | PK |
| `label_cs` | label (Czech) | TEXT | no |  |
| `label_en` | label (English) | TEXT | yes |  |

# Table `offence_record`

**Realises:** offence record (`krim:OffenceRecord`)

An offence record is an information record, kept by the Police of the Czech Republic, about one act reported to or detected by the police that is suspected to be a crime or a misdemeanour.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* The record, not the act: a record exists even when the police later conclude that the act did not occur or is not an offence (see krim:ClearanceState). Records reflect the last state while the police handled the case; later decisions of prosecutors or courts are not reflected. Only offence types whose publication has a preventive purpose are published.

| Column | Data element | SQL type | Null | Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iri` | offence record IRI | TEXT | no | UNIQUE |
| `id` | record id | INTEGER | no | PK |
| `report_datetime` | report date and time | TEXT | no |  |
| `area_id` | anonymisation area | INTEGER | no | FK -> anonymisation\_area(id) |
| `municipal_police` | recorded by municipal police | INTEGER | no |  |
| `clearance_state_code` | clearance state | INTEGER | no | FK -> clearance\_state(code) |
| `location_relevance_code` | location relevance | INTEGER | no | FK -> location\_relevance(code) |
| `state_as_of` | state as of | TEXT | no |  |

: Columns of offence_record {tbl-colwidths="[28,32,12,8,20]"}

| | |
|---|---|
| **Czech name** | stav ke dni |

| **Scope note** | Observation time, not event time: it says when the state was known, not when the act was reported (krim:reportDateTime). Records are investigated continuously and republished, so a state can change; only the latest observed state is kept, and a clearance rate is meaningful only together with this date. Taken from the publisher's 'updated' timestamp of the download that last contained the record. |

| **Cardinality** | 1..1 |
| **Business rule** | Every offence record states exactly one moment as of which its current state was reported. |
| **Status** | draft |

# Table `offence_type`

**Realises:** offence type (`krim:OffenceType`)

An offence type is a concept in the Police CR classification of offences ("Číselník tříd") that classifies offence records by the kind of act.

*Not to be confused with / scope:* Not a legal qualification under the Criminal Code; it is the publisher's own statistical classification and also contains misdemeanours, fires and traffic accidents. The classification is a hierarchy (skos:broader), and a record is tagged with a type together with all its broader types.

| `definition_en` | definition | TEXT | yes |  |

| `broader_code` | broader type | INTEGER | yes | FK -> offence\_type(code) |

# Appendix: deprecated terms

Ontology terms that are deprecated (`owl:deprecated`): kept, never deleted, so that
older data and documents stay interpretable, but not to be used for new data. The
business glossary lists current terms only.

| Term | Replaced by | Still a column | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `krim:anonymisedLatitude` (anonymised latitude) | krim:centreLatitude, krim:inAnonymisationArea | no | Deprecated in iteration 2: the published point belongs to the record's anonymisation area, not to the record. Use krim:inAnonymisationArea, then krim:centreLatitude of the area. |
| `krim:anonymisedLongitude` (anonymised longitude) | krim:centreLongitude, krim:inAnonymisationArea | no | Deprecated in iteration 2: the published point belongs to the record's anonymisation area, not to the record. Use krim:inAnonymisationArea, then krim:centreLongitude of the area. |

: Deprecated terms {tbl-colwidths="[24,24,16,36]"}

# Appendix: codelists

Allowed values of the codelist columns, from the SKOS reference data. Labels in
Czech come from the publisher; English labels and definitions are maintained in
`ontology/reference/codelist-texts.csv`.

## `kraj`

14 kraje: the standard codelist of the Czech Statistical Office, ČSÚ codelist
100 (<https://apl2.czso.cz/iSMS/cisdet.jsp?kodcis=100>); RÚIAN uses the same
codes. Not listed here.

## `orp_area`

206 ORP areas (správní obvody obcí s rozšířenou působností): the standard codelist of the Czech Statistical Office, ČSÚ codelist
65 (<https://apl2.czso.cz/iSMS/cisdet.jsp?kodcis=65>); RÚIAN uses the same
codes. Not listed here.

## `okres`

77 okresy: the standard codelist of the Czech Statistical Office, ČSÚ codelist
101 (<https://apl2.czso.cz/iSMS/cisdet.jsp?kodcis=101>); RÚIAN uses the same
codes. Not listed here.

## `municipality`

6258 municipalities and military training areas: the standard codelist of the Czech Statistical Office, ČSÚ codelist
43 (<https://apl2.czso.cz/iSMS/cisdet.jsp?kodcis=43>); RÚIAN uses the same
codes. Not listed here.

## `clearance_state`

| Code | Label (cs) | Label (en) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | zjištěn pravděpodobný pachatel | probable offender identified | A clearance state in which the police have identified a probable offender of the recorded act. |
| 2 | neobjasněno | unsolved | A clearance state in which no offender of the recorded act has been identified. |
| 3 | skutek se nestal | act did not occur | A clearance state in which the police concluded that the recorded act did not take place. |
| 4 | skutek není trestným činem | act is not an offence | A clearance state in which the police concluded that the recorded act took place but is not a crime. |

: clearance_state {tbl-colwidths="[8,22,20,50]"}

## `location_relevance`

| Code | Label (cs) | Label (en) | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Nevybráno | not selected | A location relevance indicating that no meaning was assigned to the recorded location. |
| 2 | Místo oznámení | place of report | A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the act was reported. |
| 3 | Místo následku | place of consequence | A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the consequence of the act occurred. |
| 4 | Místo spáchání | place of commission | A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the act was committed. |
| 5 | Zahraniční lokalita | foreign location | A location relevance indicating that the act relates to a place outside the Czech Republic. |
| 6 | Chybná lokalita | erroneous location | A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is known to be wrong. |
